landfall-green.note: The Secret Menu runs a brighter guest step (#4ecb8d) as deliberate section identity.

display.purpose: Page heroes only; one per page. Mixed-case always; tracked caps never climb to page scale.

title.purpose: Card titles. Drawer-card and pin-card names inside tools run the cartographic variant: 14px, uppercase, tracking 0.09em.

body.purpose: Prose at weight 400; the 300 weight is retired on dark. Thin-on-dark reads generated.

label.purpose: Everything that is data: eyebrows, sources, stat captions, coordinates. Always IBM Plex Mono, uppercase, letterspaced. Fact-row labels are mono captions at 9 to 9.5px tracked 0.12em (The Caption Rule). Working sizes inside tools legitimately run 8.5 to 12.5px.

shadows.name: card-lift
shadows.purpose: Appears only with the hover translateY(-4px) lift.

shadows.name: fab-rest
shadows.purpose: The one resting shadow, earned by floating over a map canvas.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Color, border, and opacity state changes.

motion.name: structural
motion.purpose: Sheets, lifts, and layout moves. HUKit.dcap caps any duration at 250ms on phones and 0 under reduced motion.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: The house easing for anything that moves.

narrative.overview:
Healthcare Uncharted looks like a working explorer's atlas of the healthcare system: dense with real data, annotated in monospace, built to be used in the field rather than admired on a shelf. Every surface starts from deep navy water, and the content IS the light: white display type, fog-blue prose, and one teal signal that marks where the reader should look next. Data is never decoration here.

The Quiet Precision era (adopted 2026-08-06): hierarchy comes from type and space, not from effects. State is ink and weight, never a halo. Boxes dissolve into rules: stat tiles stand on a 2px top rule, callouts read as margin notes on open ground, toolbars are mastheads over one strong rule. The cartographic layer whispers on top: hairline survey ticks at two corners of outer surfaces in border gray, tracked-caps names at drawer-card scale, mono caption labels, tiny geometric markers leading catalog rows. Glows, gradient accent bars, tinted callout panels, and 300-weight body on dark are retired.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first: deep navy pages where content carries the light; a full light theme exists and flips by token, never by redesign
One teal signal (#4ECDC4) does the pointing; chart blue (#1B5FA8) does the acting
State is ink and weight: selection reads as a solid fill or an ink change plus weight, never a glow
Monospace is the voice of data: every label, source line, and coordinate is IBM Plex Mono, small and letterspaced
Bordered, tonal depth; shadows are reserved for things that move or float
Real data density, phone-honest: 44px touch floor and a one-transient-surface rule on every interactive tool

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal Teal points at one thing per view: the active state, the live value, the place to look. If teal is everywhere, it is nowhere. Chart Blue owns actions so teal can stay a signal.

rules.name: The Deep-Step Rule
rules.body: Any accent used as TEXT on a light surface drops to its deep step (--teal-dk, --amber-dk, or the per-lens dark values). Tinted backgrounds keep the bright hue; text never does.

rules.name: The Earned Color Rule
rules.body: Data color appears only when the reader chose the metric. Maps rest in neutral teal-tinted fills until a lens or shading is picked; a tint nobody asked for reads as unexplained decoration.

rules.name: The Ink State Rule
rules.body: State is ink and weight, never light. Active means a solid teal fill with deep-water ink (#062024) and weight 700, or an ink shift plus a rule; it never means a glow, halo, or tinted wash.

rules.name: The Data Speaks Mono Rule
rules.body: If a string is a value, a unit, a source, a date, or a coordinate, it is set in IBM Plex Mono. If it is a sentence, it is DM Sans. No exceptions; this is how readers learn what is checkable.

rules.name: The CAPS Rule
rules.body: Emphasis is CAPS or a heavier weight, never italics and never bold-inside-prose. UI strings follow the same voice kernel as editorial: no em dashes, middots join fragments.

rules.name: The Caption Rule
rules.body: Fact-row labels and data captions are mono captions: 9.5px, uppercase, tracked 0.12em or wider, FOG BLUE (--t2). Faded Ink captions failed QA on open dark ground (2026-08-06); Faded Ink is reserved for source lines, meta, and section labels that should recede. Names at drawer-card scale go tracked caps (14px / 0.09em); page H1s and editorial card titles stay mixed-case Outfit 800. Values set tabular-nums wherever figures align.

rules.name: The Border-First Rule
rules.body: If a container needs definition at rest, it gets a Sounding Line border and a tonal step, never a shadow. A shadow at rest must be justified by floating above a live canvas.

rules.name: The Survey Tick Rule
rules.body: Outer surfaces may carry two hairline corner ticks: 10px arms, 1px, Sounding Line Bold, top-left and bottom-right, inset about 5px. Border gray, never accent, never on nested elements.

rules.name: The Ruled Figure Rule
rules.body: Stat tiles are ruled figures: value over mono caption on a 2px top rule, no fill, no border box. The figure owns the ground it sits on, the way a table in print does.

rules.name: The Margin Note Rule
rules.body: Callouts are margin notes, not panels: a 3px accent left rule against open ground, 14px lead-in, no background tint, no border box, no radius.

dos: Do point with Signal Teal and act with Chart Blue; keep the two jobs separate.
Do caption every data element in Plex Mono with its source; a number without a walkable source does not ship.
Do draw containers with Sounding Line borders and tonal steps; save shadows for movement and floating chrome.
Do keep the 44px touch floor, the 699px phone line, and the 250ms phone motion cap on every interactive surface.
Do let cards lift (-4px), buttons press, and arrows slide; tactile response is the brand's handshake, within the budget.
Do flip accent text to its deep step on light surfaces (The Deep-Step Rule).
Do dissolve boxes into rules where the content can stand on open ground: ruled stat figures, margin-note callouts, masthead toolbars.
Do check every reskinned surface in BOTH themes; a rule that vanishes on light is a regression, not a style.
donts: Don't use em dashes anywhere, including UI strings, aria labels, and CSS comments; middots join fragments.
Don't color data the reader did not ask for; resting maps stay neutral (The Earned Color Rule).
Don't ship literal pictogram icons on maps or dashboards; geometric symbols only.
Don't stack transient surfaces; one sheet, drawer, or overlay at a time on phones.
Don't render the 4Ps as page structure or labeled headers; they are pills and picker sections only.
Don't introduce new fonts, new accent hues, or a fifth tonal step; the ladder is the system.
Don't glow: no zero-offset halos, no colored hover radiance, no box-shadow as emphasis (The Ink State Rule).
Don't run gradient accent bars or gradient text; accents are solid, one hue, drawn like rules.
Don't set body or description text at weight 300 on dark; 400 is the floor.
Don't put survey ticks on nested elements or draw them in accent color; two corners, border gray, outer surfaces only (The Survey Tick Rule).
